div.div: Errors: a failed logman call leaves the state unchanged and the view shows the PerfmonError: Unsupported (not Windows; nothing runs), AccessDenied (run elevated), Invalid (bad set name), Io (logman did not start or timed out: 120 s, setting tools.logmanTimeout 5–600 s), Failed {code, message}.

div.div: Driver: PerfmonController runs logman through CommandRunner and never touches the registry. PerfmonView / PerfmonStore call perfmon_install, perfmon_control {start | stop | delete | query} and perfmon_outputs: compatibility wrappers over the tool perfmon.sets (Windows only, needs elevation, unavailable in safe mode).
